LanguageData.ResearchGuidenceSystem.ResearchDesc:
The guidance system increases the maximum range of strategic missiles, allow them to reach virtually any target on the planet.

This is a passive upgrade, once research has been completed all missiles will benefit from it without any further action being needed.
